question: Which of the following is a variety of oilseed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taramira**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Taramira oil, commonly known as Jamba oil.
 
• Taramira oil is a seed oil, pressed from the seeds of the arugula.
 
• The plant of Tamaria oilseed is highly drought-resistant, the oil is popular in regions of poor rainfall, particularly in West Asia, Pakistan, and Northern India.
 
• Taramira seeds are oilseeds and are mostly used in cattle feed. 
 
• It is also used in hair oil and skincare products.
